title: Late Payment and Returned Payment Fees, with Courtesy Reversal Allowances, Personal Credit Cards
content:
**The charges.** A late payment fee is billed at one of two amounts on Personal Credit Cards: the first-occurrence amount, charged when no late fee was billed in the lookback cycles, and the repeat amount, charged when one was. A returned payment fee is billed when a payment is returned unpaid.

**The courtesy allowance.** Each tier also fixes how many courtesy late fee reversals a customer may receive in a rolling 365 days and how many consecutive on-time payments must stand immediately before the late statement for such a reversal.

| Tier | First-occurrence late fee | Repeat late fee | Lookback cycles searched | Returned payment fee | Courtesy reversals per 365 days | Consecutive on-time payments required |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa | 29.00 USD | 40.00 USD | 6 | 29.00 USD | 1 | 6 |
| College Rewards Visa | 25.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 6 | 25.00 USD | 1 | 3 |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | 32.00 USD | 41.00 USD | 6 | 32.00 USD | 1 | 6 |
| Cash Rewards Visa | 32.00 USD | 41.00 USD | 6 | 32.00 USD | 1 | 6 |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | 32.00 USD | 41.00 USD | 6 | 32.00 USD | 2 | 3 |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | 32.00 USD | 41.00 USD | 6 | 32.00 USD | 3 | 0 |

**Points of judgement on the figures.**

*Which tier never charges more for a repeat?* College Rewards Visa alone, where the first-occurrence and repeat amounts are both 25.00 USD.

*How far back is the search for an earlier late fee?* 6 statement cycles on every tier.

*Which tier asks for no prior on-time payments before a courtesy reversal?* Visa Infinite Private Client, whose requirement is 0, and which also allows the most courtesy reversals in a rolling 365 days, 3. Travel Rewards Visa Signature allows 2 and asks for 3; the remaining four tiers allow 1.

*Is the returned payment fee ever different from the first-occurrence late fee?* On these six tiers it is not: each tier prices both at the same amount.
